description: Recursive instrumental-variable estimator for regressions with correlated disturbances.
implementation_notes: This is a proposed roadmap item; the current UEF specification does not define its API or equations. Purpose: Recursive instrumental-variable estimator for regressions with correlated disturbances. Family contract work: declare state and measurement ordering, process/measurement models, covariance/noise assumptions, timestamp and missing-measurement policy, innovation handling, and PSD-preserving updates. Define instrument generation, rank checks, covariance/forgetting policy, and instrument validity assumptions. Before coding, define typed configuration and fixed-size state, dimensions and units, initialization/reset, aliasing, coefficient/model ownership, numeric conditioning and overflow behavior, deterministic worst-case work and memory, and state/output preservation on failure. Specify a direct C API first; add a UEF-owned generated wrapper only after the same behavior is implemented and reviewed. Keep registered=false and outputs empty.
